area: src/engine_trealla.c — the engine port's runtime optimiser, seen through core's PrologEngine seam (corebridge/js/host-prolog-engine.js) over libinsimul
description: PL.native-kb-instantiation-error. Same format and driver as incremental.json (expect, cost, probes, oracle comparison). The pinned engine's frame recovery, on, unbound variables that were bound BEFORE a goal which backtracks through an asserted rule holding an if-then-else; every clause here is asserted (the bootstrap loads programs with assertz/1). A host query then lost its own variable_names list: the bootstrap's result writer raised instantiation_error(list) outside its catch, the engine printed `   true  error(instantiation_error,list).` to stdout, and the answer was one binding set with no bindings. The first case is the smallest program that shows it; the second is the strategy turn that found it (core's strategy/run case 'an authored farm price ...': the hand at brook_pottery cannot be fed), with its fact writes kept on the incremental path. tests/prolog_engine_cases.c also fails a file during which the library wrote anything to stdout.

cases.name: a strategy turn whose hand cannot be fed: the shortfall answers in full after incremental writes, and the hand goes home incrementally

steps.program:
:- dynamic(strategy_resource/1).
:- dynamic(strategy_trade_output/3).
:- dynamic(strategy_worker_upkeep/2).
:- dynamic(strategy_faction/1).
:- dynamic(strategy_holds/2).
:- dynamic(strategy_stock/3).
:- dynamic(strategy_worker/2).
:- dynamic(business/1).
:- dynamic(business_type/2).
:- dynamic(business_out_of_business/1).
strategy_sum([], 0).
strategy_sum([X | T], S) :- strategy_sum(T, S0), S is S0 + X.
strategy_length([], 0).
strategy_length([_ | T], N) :- strategy_length(T, N0), N is N0 + 1.
strategy_trading(B) :- business(B), \+ business_out_of_business(B).
strategy_stock_of(F, Res, Amount) :- nonvar(F), strategy_resource(Res), ( strategy_stock(F, Res, A0) -> Amount = A0 ; Amount = 0 ).
strategy_hands(B, Hands) :- findall(W, strategy_worker(B, W), Ws), strategy_length(Ws, N), Hands is N + 1.
strategy_output(B, Res, Amount) :- strategy_trading(B), business_type(B, T), strategy_trade_output(T, Res, Per), strategy_hands(B, Hands), Amount is Per * Hands.
strategy_income(F, Res, Total) :- strategy_faction(F), strategy_resource(Res), findall(A, (strategy_holds(F, B), strategy_output(B, Res, A)), As), strategy_sum(As, Total).
strategy_upkeep(F, Res, Total) :- strategy_faction(F), strategy_resource(Res), findall(W, (strategy_holds(F, B), strategy_worker(B, W)), Ws), strategy_length(Ws, N), ( strategy_worker_upkeep(Res, Per) -> true ; Per = 0 ), Total is N * Per.
strategy_net(F, Res, Net) :- strategy_income(F, Res, In), strategy_upkeep(F, Res, Out), Net is In - Out.
strategy_shortfall(F, Res, Short) :- strategy_net(F, Res, Net), strategy_stock_of(F, Res, Have), Short is 0 - (Have + Net), Short > 0.

steps.goal: strategy_net(player, R, N), strategy_stock_of(player, R, E)
